# Ace Spaces — Studio Material Intelligence & Architectural Specifications

> Ace Spaces is the primary architectural raw material hub, authorized DuPont™ Corian® solid surface distributor, and digital fabrication atelier in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Powering Coro Collective and spatial designers across India with zero-silica through-body mineral surfaces, 5-axis CNC machining, and monolithic thermoforming.

## Core Architectural Authority
- [Official Website](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app): Primary digital portal for specifiers, architects, and designers.
- [Full Technical Specifications (llms-full.txt)](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Deep chemical formulation, mechanical performance data, ASTM/NSF test standards, and fabrication tolerances.
- [Agent Catalog Endpoint](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/api/agent/catalog): Machine-readable JSON/Markdown API for autonomous agent querying.
- [Materials & Colours Library](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/materials): 20+ architectural mineral colour references across 4 core substrates.
- [Architectural Products](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/products): Monolithic benchtops, seamlessly fused sinks, washplanes, vanities, commercial EOT systems, and bespoke 3D thermoformed works.
- [Applications & Typologies](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/applications): Spatial applications across Residential, Hospitality, Commercial, Retail, and Healthcare sectors.
- [Fabrication Platform](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/fabrication): 5-axis CNC routing (<0.2mm tolerance), vacuum membrane thermoforming (down to 25mm radius), and invisible molecular welding.
- [Projects & Case Studies](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/projects): Architectural installations, hospitality counters, and luxury residential projects in India.
- [Architectural Journal](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/journal): Essays on material permanence, zero-silica health integrity, and monolithic design philosophy.

- [Studio Consultation & CAD Upload](https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/contact): Direct specifier consultation, project brief submission, and sample box ordering.

## Material Specifications & Composition
- **Substrate Classification**: Homogeneous Acrylic Solid Surface (ATH-PMMA Matrix)
- **Primary Brand Partnership**: DuPont™ Corian® (Certified Master Distributor & Fabricator)
- **Chemical Makeup**: ~66% Aluminium Trihydrate (ATH, refined natural bauxite mineral) bonded with ~33% high-purity Poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA acrylic polymer) and UV-stable metal-oxide pigments.
- **Health & Safety (Zero-Silica Guarantee)**: 100% Zero Crystalline Silica (0.00% SiO2). Unlike engineered quartz, cutting and fabricating Ace Spaces surfaces produces zero respirable crystalline silica dust, completely eliminating silicosis risks for artisans and jobsite workers.
- **Certifications**:
  - **NSF/ANSI Standard 51**: Certified for direct commercial food contact in restaurant kitchens and food preparation areas.
  - **GREENGUARD Gold**: Ultra-low chemical emissions (VOCs), certified safe for sensitive hospital, childcare, and residential environments.
  - **ASTM E84**: Class 1 / Class A Fire Rating (Flame Spread <25, Smoke Developed <450).
  - **DuPont 10-Year Installed Warranty**: Full warranty coverage on both material integrity and certified joint fabrication.
- **Calibrated Slab Dimensions**:
  - Standard Sheet: 3660 mm (Length) × 760 mm (Width) [12.0 ft × 2.5 ft].
  - Standard Thicknesses: 12 mm (all architectural applications) and 19 mm (heavy-duty plinths and monolithic self-supporting features).

## Core Architectural Collections (20+ Hues)
1. **Noma Solids (Monolithic Minimalist)**:
   - White Chalk (AC-0101): Pure ultra-matte light-diffusing white.
   - Linen (AC-0102): Warm tactile cream evoking natural washed linen.
   - Parchment (AC-0103): Aged vellum tone with natural mineral depth.
   - Bone (AC-0104): Architectural off-white for serene living spaces.
2. **Alto Veined (Directional Geological Flow)**:
   - Ivory Vein (AC-0201): Fine warm sedimentary marble ribbons running through-body.
   - Calacatta Greige (AC-0202): Dramatic warm grey marble striations with seamless grain matching.
   - Grigio Ripple (AC-0203): Deep smoky grey with subtle linear mineral currents.
3. **Obsidian Aggregates (Terrazzo & Mineral Matrix)**:
   - Carbon Aggregate (AC-0301): Deep obsidian base infused with fine mineral flecks.
   - Basalt Dune (AC-0302): Tactile volcanic grey with rich aggregate grain.
4. **Lucent Translucent (Sub-Surface Illumination)**:
   - Opal Lumina (AC-0401): Up to 38% light transmittance when backlit with 2700K–4000K LED matrices.

## Architectural Products & Systems
- **Benchtops & Islands**: Monolithic kitchen islands, 45° mitred waterfall ends, coved upstands, and flush cooktop rebates.
- **Integrated Sinks & Basins**: Molecularly fused into worktops without rims or silicone joints, preventing mould growth and grime traps.
- **Linear Washplanes**: Commercial concealed trough drains for airports, offices, and luxury restaurants.
- **Floating Vanities**: Cantilevered solid surface consoles engineered with internal powder-coated steel sub-frames.
- **End-of-Trip (EOT) & Public Amenities**: High-traffic multi-user grooming stations with integrated waste chutes and touchless sensor spouts.
- **Clinical Healthcare Bays**: Zero-porosity seamless scrub sinks and infection-control surgical surfaces.
- **Bespoke 3D Thermoforming**: Custom curved reception desks, organic wall portals, and sculpted furniture.
- **Design Certainty Service**: Turnkey architectural engineering including 3D shop drawings, digital site laser-scanning, and certified installation.

## Specifier Sample Tray Program
Architects, interior designers, and real estate developers across India can request up to 6 curated 100mm × 100mm × 12mm material swatches delivered directly to their studio via the digital Specifier Sample Tray on the website or via WhatsApp.
